purpose: 按三固定返回顺序选择同原统计季度稿，各一首GET，无失败换载体或重试
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import hashlib, json, re, requests
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_prior_use_source_v1"
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def read(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("首次取得或选择记录已存在，禁止重试："+str(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return str(p.relative_to(root)).replace("\\","/")
protocol=read(out/"protocol.json")
assert sha((out/"protocol.json").read_bytes())=="d206290a70bc75357035203fd4bdafe653d3516a5ab99a7f9ec8828164479a68"
selected=[]
for case in protocol["fixed_cases"]:
    q=case["fixed_target_loan_stat_quarter"]
    raw_path=out/f"固定定位原返回_{q}_E114.json"
    raw=read(raw_path)
    assert raw["status"]=="fulfilled"
    s=raw["raw_tool_result"] if isinstance(raw["raw_tool_result"],str) else json.dumps(raw["raw_tool_result"],ensure_ascii=False)
    candidates=[]
    choice=None
    for rank,part in enumerate(re.split(r"-{30,}",s),start=1):
        first=part.strip().split("\n")[0]
        m=re.search(r"^(.*?)\s*\((https?://[^)]+)\)$",first)
        if not m:
            candidates.append({"rank":rank,"title_url":first,"status":"UNPARSED_NOT_SELECTED"})
            continue
        title,url=m.groups()
        compact=re.sub(r"\s+","",title)
        year=int(q[:4]); quarter=int(q[-1]); label={1:"一",2:"二",3:"三",4:"四"}[quarter]
        match=str(year) in compact and (label+"季度" in compact or "第"+label+"季度" in compact) and "金融机构贷款投向统计报告" in compact
        whole_report_title=match and not any(word in compact for word in ["点评","解读","发布一季度","支持重点","主要监管指标"])
        eligible=whole_report_title and (".gov.cn/" in url or ".pbc.gov.cn/" in url)
        row={"rank":rank,"title":title,"url":url,"matching_fixed_year_quarter_report":eligible,"selected":False}
        if eligible and choice is None:
            choice={"quarter":q,"economic_period":case["economic_period"],"same_original_cutoff":case["same_original_cutoff"],
                    "rank":rank,"title":title,"url":url,"quantity_and_clock_pending":True,
                    "raw_search_return_sha256":sha(raw_path.read_bytes())}
            row["selected"]=True
        candidates.append(row)
    selected.append({"quarter":q,"candidates":candidates,"chosen":choice,"unknown_if_no_match":choice is None})
selection_path=save("三固定原季度全部定位选择_E114.json",{"at":now(),"rows":selected,"chosen_before_GET":True,"no_extra_queries":True})
jobs=[]
for x in selected:
    if x["chosen"] is not None:
        choice=x["chosen"]
        q=choice["quarter"]
        save(f"{q}_唯一新首次GET认领_E114.json",{"at":now(),"attempt":1,"selection":choice,"TLS_verify":True,"timeouts_seconds":[12,30],"retry":0,"allow_redirects":False,"authenticated":False})
        jobs.append(choice)
def fetch(choice):
    q=choice["quarter"]
    result={"at_started":now(),"selection":choice,"attempt":1,"retry":0,"TLS_verify":True,"allow_redirects":False,"authenticated":False}
    try:
        response=requests.get(choice["url"],timeout=(12,30),verify=True,allow_redirects=False,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
        raw=response.content
        suffix=".pdf" if raw.startswith(b"%PDF") else ".html"
        p=out/f"{q}_唯一新首次取得原响应_E114{suffix}"
        if p.exists():
            raise RuntimeError("首次响应已存在")
        p.write_bytes(raw)
        result.update({"at_completed":now(),"http_status":response.status_code,"response_content_type":response.headers.get("Content-Type"),
                       "bytes":len(raw),"path":str(p.relative_to(root)).replace("\\","/"),"sha256":sha(raw),
                       "status":"RAW_HTTP200_QUANTITY_AND_CLOCK_PENDING" if response.status_code==200 else "RAW_HTTP_NON200_UNKNOWN",
                       "redirect_location":response.headers.get("Location")})
    except Exception as exc:
        result.update({"at_completed":now(),"status":"TRANSPORT_ERROR_UNKNOWN_NO_RETRY","error_type":type(exc).__name__,"error_message":str(exc)[:600]})
    save(f"{q}_唯一新首次GET回执_E114.json",result)
    return result
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
    results=list(pool.map(fetch,jobs))
save("三固定定位与首次取得完成_E114.json",{
    "at":now(),"actual_fixed_queries":3,"actual_new_first_GETs":len(jobs),
    "raw_http200":sum(r.get("http_status")==200 for r in results),
    "no_match_quarters":[x["quarter"] for x in selected if x["chosen"] is None],
    "source_quantity_clock_pending":True,"retries":0,"extra_queries":0,"alternate_carriers":0,
    "authenticated_requests":0,"results":results,"finite_acquisition_completed":True,
    "source_selection_artifact":selection_path,"financial_attempts":0
})
print(json.dumps({"actual_fixed_queries":3,"actual_new_first_GETs":len(jobs),"raw_HTTP_results":[{k:r.get(k) for k in ["selection","http_status","bytes","path","status","error_type"]} for r in results]},ensure_ascii=False))
